_comment: Allowlist for the PDFs shown in the PUBLIC Knowledge Center 'Reports' section.
It is empty on purpose. /api/pdfs is a directory listing of the research pool —
the corpus the RAG grounding index reads — and the Knowledge Center used to render
that listing verbatim on a public marketing page. What was actually being published:
• third-party copyrighted material we have no right to redistribute — a 1964
Bjorken & Drell physics textbook, Osborne/Rubinstein game-theory texts, the
Dunnigan wargames handbook, commercial research from GWI / IDHL / Smartsheet /
Clifford Chance, and a Zero Hash user agreement
• internal first-party documents — a Kalshi/Ko-fi revenue report, Polymarket
• ten uploads whose filenames are raw content hashes, plus one called '8495630 (1)'
Ingesting a document for retrieval is not a decision to publish it. Add an entry here
only for a report that is OURS and meant for the public; anything else stays in the
pool, where the grounding index can still read it. Admins signed in see the whole
pool on the page regardless, so ingest and cleanup workflows are unaffected.
